youtube.title: Why Is This Ground Burning for 250 Years? #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Under your feet, the earth is burning, and it has been since 1962. This is Centralia, Pennsylvania, once a small coal-mining town with churches, bars, family homes and kids on bikes. Beneath it ran one of the richest seams of hard coal in America, riddled with old mine tunnels. Coal built this town, and nobody imagined it would also destroy it. By some estimates there is enough coal down there to burn for up to 250 years. Full episode on the channel.
